brief:
A Turkish academic staged a protest in Trabzon by suspending himself from a crane in solidarity with Gaza's doctors, Shehab Wire reported. The demonstration aimed to draw attention to alleged abuses against Palestinian physicians and prisoners, as well as the suffering of displaced residents facing the approaching winter.

The activist used the dramatic action to highlight humanitarian conditions in Gaza and call for international awareness of violations against medical staff and detainees.

title: Turkish academic hangs from crane to protest Gaza abuses
